test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who is the Union Minister of Communications and Electronics & Information Technology in India, as of November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashwini Vaishnaw.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ashwini Vaishnaw:**

 
 
• Since 2021, Ashwini Vaishnaw, an Indian politician and former IAS officer.
 
• He has held the positions of 39th Minister of Railways, 55th Minister of Communications, and 2nd Minister of Electronics and Information Technology in the Government of India.
 
• He has also served as an Odisha representative in the Rajya Sabha since 2019. 
 
• He has a background in engineering and business, having studied at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Kanpur and the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kiran Rijiju:**

 
 
• Arunachal Pradesh-born Indian politician Kiren Rijiju has represented Arunachal West in the Lok Sabha since 2014 and from 2004 to 2009.
 
• From July 7, 2021, to May 18, 2023, he served as the 34th Minister of Law and Justice, succeeding Ravi Shankar Prasad.
 
• Currently, he has been serving as the Government of India's Cabinet Minister for Earth Sciences.
 
• Indian politician Arjun Ram Meghwal has been the Government of India's Minister of Law and Justice (Independent Charge) since 2023.
 
 
 
• **Narayan Rane:**
 
 
• He is an Indian politician who served as **Maharashtra's thirteenth Chief minister**, was born on April 10, 1952.
 
• **He is the Minister of Micro, Small, and Medium-Sized Enterprises at the moment.**
 
• He l**aunched the Maharashtra Swabhiman Paksha in September of 2017.**
 
• He announced his support for the Bharatiya Janta Party in 2018 and was chosen to serve in the Rajya Sabha from the BJP.
 
• He merged his party, Maharashtra Swabhiman Paksha, into the BJP on October 15, 2019, and joined the Bhartiya Janta Party.
 
 
 
• **Anurag Thakur:**
 
 
• Anurag Singh Thakur, a member of the Lok Sabha representing **Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh**, is an Indian politician affiliated with the Bharatiya Janata Party.
 
• He was born on October 24, 1974.
 
• He **currently serves as the Minister of Youth Affairs, Sports, and Broadcasting and Information.**
 
• In a by-election held in May 2008, he was initially chosen as a Bharatiya Janata Party candidate to serve in the Lok Sabha.
 
• **From May 2015 until February 2017, he presided over the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) as its president.**
